title: Resource requests
description: Material, equipment and lab-time needs. Approval is the coordinator's human decision, justified with a written note.
editableHint: You can edit this request while it is “New”.

empty.title: No resource requests yet
empty.hint: Need equipment, materials or lab time? Create a new request.
empty.hintReadonly: Requests appear here once the team creates them.

form.dialogDescription: The coordinator reviews the request and records the decision with a note. You can edit it while it is “New”.
form.title: What is needed?
form.titleHint: Short and specific, e.g. “3D printing time (6 hours)”.
form.detailsHint: Why it is needed, quantity and technical requirements.
form.partnerHint: Active partners and partners in negotiation.
form.neededByHint: Leave empty if there is no specific date.

decide.title: Decision on request
decide.description: The new status is sent to the requester and the team, and written to the audit log.
decide.noteHintRequired: Required to approve or reject: {min}–{max} characters.
decide.noteHintOptional: Optional. If left empty for “Done”, the approval note is kept.

errors.datePast: The needed-by date cannot be in the past.
errors.noteRequired: The decision note must be 10–1000 characters.
errors.noteLong: The note can be 1000 characters at most.
errors.transition: This status change is not allowed.
errors.locked: The request is already in review and can no longer be edited.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission for this action.
errors.changed: The request was changed in the meantime. Refresh the page and try again.
